help.title: Help: {screen}
help.none: This screen has no help text yet. Press Ctrl+K to go anywhere, or ask your admin.
help.home:
Your day at a glance: files you have checked out, approvals waiting for you, and what was released lately.

Click a row to open it. The bell at the top lists your notifications; Ctrl+K takes you anywhere.
help.kosha:
The Explorer holds every file in folders, like Windows Explorer.

Drag files in to add them. Right-click a file to check it out (so nobody else changes it), check it in with your changes, rename, move or delete it. Released files are locked: make a new revision to change them.

Deleted files wait in the recycle bin.
help.inputs:
Inputs are what arrives from outside: customer drawings, mails, photos, notes from site visits.

File each one on a project, part or change so the team finds it later. Projects hold the folders for one order.
help.boms:
A BOM lists the parts of an assembly and how many of each.

Open a BOM to edit its lines while it is a draft; release it to lock it and send it to the ERP. Views and cost show the BOM as released, as it is being worked on, or as built for one machine.
help.changes:
A change order (ECO) changes released parts in a controlled way: what changes, why, and who approved it.

Add the files, send it for approval, and implement it once approved. A change request (ECR) is the idea that starts it.
help.deviations: A deviation allows a part to be made differently from its drawing for a limited quantity or time, with approval. Nothing on the drawing changes.
help.erp:
Released parts and BOMs are sent to the ERP from here. Waiting transfers are retried by themselves; failed ones show the ERP's own message and a Retry button.

Orders shows purchase orders that need drawings; Reconciliation compares Kosha with the ERP.
help.common: Duplicates finds parts that are drawn twice under different numbers, so the team can keep one.
help.library: Standard parts (bolts, bearings, washers) from the installed packs. Pick a size to get its part number without drawing it.
help.admin: Settings for the whole company: users and roles, numbering, packs, backups, sign-in, notifications and add-ins. Only admins and approvers see this.
help.search: Everything that matches what you typed. Short forms and Hinglish work: "brg hsg 80" or "32 teeth wala gear ka drawing".
help.shop: The shop view shows the released drawing of a part, large and read-only. Type the part number or scan the QR code on the job card.
